goals.title: Restore the third daily meal at Bethesda
goals.description: The boarding students receive two meals a day; the school had to cut the third. What restoring it costs is set out on the numbers page, down to the cost per student.
goals.target_note: the low end of the staples-only estimate from the October 2026 feeding analysis.
